themeCSS: .label, .nodeLabel, .edgeLabel { font-family: Inter, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 400; } .node rect, .node polygon, .node path, .cluster rect { rx: 10px; ry: 10px; } .cluster rect { fill: #f7f8fa; stroke: #e5e7eb; } .edgePath .path, .flowchart-link { stroke-width: 1.25px; } .node rect { stroke-width: 1px; } .label text, .nodeLabel, .edgeLabel { fill: #5f6368; } .edgeLabel rect, .edgeLabel .labelBkg { fill: transparent; background-color: transparent; } .marker { fill: #8a8f98; stroke: #8a8f98; }
